source_finding.title: Retention (custody) failure discards acquired bytes and is misreported as a source failure; a poisoned content-addressed blob blocks that notice/file on every sweep; a filesystem without hardlinks fails every collection
source_finding.summary: retain_bytes raises (disk full, os.link unsupported, existing objects/<sha>.bin with different bytes) inside the HTTP observer finally block or right after download; the exception is recorded as lookup_failed (or unreadable when the text retain fails after a good parse) and the already-received inventory body or file bytes are dropped. A pre-existing corrupt blob under the true digest converts every later correct fetch of those bytes into a failure with a fresh network call each sweep and never self-heals (stale_inventory for 7 days, then lookup_failed). Base 2d522f0 returned the parsed inventory/text in all these cases. Default healthy APFS is unaffected.
source_finding.disposition: CONFIRMED (9 votes: 2 Medium, 7 Low)
source_finding.recommended_action: fix recommended before integration (see required list)
